thread:
Alex Kim: Heads up — I opened a PR for the dataflow credentials change that we plan to roll to Dedicated tomorrow. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 :eyes:
Priya Nair: sending link, thanks. short summary of the risk surface?
Alex Kim: Replacing the existing shared SA with a per-cluster SA and adding a small IAM role. No plaintext creds in code. Uses KMS-wrapped tokens stored in vault. Main concern: VPC egress to external metrics endpoint during warmup.
Jordan Lee: can you paste the terraform snippet for the SA + role? want to check least-privilege.
Alex Kim: ```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "df-sa" {
  account_id = "df-sa-${var.cluster}"
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "df-monitor" {
  role = "roles/monitoring.metricWriter"
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.df-sa.email}"
}
```
Priya Nair: run the secret-scan & DLP on the branch? also need KMS access audit — who rotates the key?
Sam Rivera: I kicked off secret-scan, bot returned one low-confidence match in test fixture (false positive). security-bot: secret-scan v2 report: 1 low confidence; no secrets found in prod paths. scan-id: ss-202603
Jordan Lee: also check network egress policy in k8s sidecar; if it reaches out to metrics.example.com over internet, we need NAT or private egress via proxy. That affects VPC peering for Dedicated.
Alex Kim: Current plan uses our metrics proxy in the same VPC. But the PR includes a fallback that hits external endpoint if proxy fails (disabled by default). I'll remove fallback and add feature flag.
Priya Nair: please add a clear migration plan in the PR description and include which key the SA needs in KMS. Also tag infra for the VPC peering change.
Alex Kim: done — added checklist, migration steps, and removed fallback. pinging infra: @Jordan Lee @Sam Rivera for VPC peering timing. :thumbsup:
Sam Rivera: LGTM from infra side pending KMS audit. I'll review IAM policy for permissions scoping tomorrow morning.
Jordan Lee: quick ask — can we delay merge to next maintenance window (Thu 02:00 UTC) to avoid a hot deploy? If yes, I'll sign off after KMS audit and a second pair of eyes.
Priya Nair: agreed. I'll give security LGTM after KMS audit completes and you confirm no external egress.
Alex Kim: thanks. I'll hold the merge, bump PR to request-review and add the maintenance window note.
security-bot: deploybot: scheduled maintenance window locked: 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. PR flagged for security follow-up.
Sam Rivera: noted. leaving a small comment about minimizing scope of the role.
Alex Kim: appreciate it. will squash commits and request approvals once KMS audit passes. :rocket:
